<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\BookingCancellation;
use App\Models\BookingRecurring;
use App\Models\BookingSlot;
use App\Models\Court;
use App\Models\CourtSlot;
use App\Models\Deposit;
use App\Models\Member;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class BookingService
{
    public function __construct(
        private PricingService $pricing,
        private DocumentNumberService $numbers,
        private CashService $cash,
        private MemberService $members,
        private PaymentService $payments,
        private AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {
    }

    public function quote(Court $court, Carbon $date, string $startTime, int $duration, ?Member $member = null): array
    {
        return $this->pricing->quote($court, $date, $startTime, $duration, $member);
    }

    public function create(array $data, User $user, bool $hold = false): Booking
    {
        $court = Court::findOrFail($data['court_id']);
        if (! $court->is_active) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['court_id' => 'Lapangan ini sedang tidak aktif.']);
        }

        $date = Carbon::parse($data['booking_date'])->startOfDay();
        $member = ! empty($data['member_id']) ? Member::with('subscriptions.membershipType')->find($data['member_id']) : null;

        if ($member && in_array($member->status, ['blacklist', 'suspend'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['member_id' => 'Member ini tidak diizinkan melakukan booking.']);
        }

        if ($date->lt(now()->startOfDay())) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking_date' => 'Tanggal booking tidak boleh di masa lalu.']);
        }

        $advance = $member
            ? (int) setting('member_advance_days', 30)
            : (int) setting('public_advance_days', 14);

        if (now()->startOfDay()->diffInDays($date, false) > $advance) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'booking_date' => 'Booking maksimal ' . $advance . ' hari ke depan untuk tipe penyewa ini.',
            ]);
        }

        $duration = (int) $data['duration_minutes'];
        $quote = $this->pricing->quote($court, $date, $data['start_time'], $duration, $member);
        $slotTimes = $this->pricing->slotTimes($data['start_time'], $duration);
        $expiresAt = $hold ? now()->addMinutes((int) setting('hold_minutes', 15)) : null;

        try {
            return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $user, $court, $date, $member, $quote, $slotTimes, $hold, $expiresAt) {
                foreach ($slotTimes as $time) {
                    DB::table('court_slots')->insertOrIgnore([
                        'court_id' => $court->id,
                        'slot_date' => $date->toDateString(),
                        'slot_time' => $time,
                        'status' => 'open',
                        'created_at' => now(),
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);
                }

                $locked = CourtSlot::query()
                    ->where('court_id', $court->id)
                    ->whereDate('slot_date', $date->toDateString())
                    ->whereIn('slot_time', $slotTimes)
                    ->orderBy('slot_time')
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->get();

                foreach ($locked as $slot) {
                    if (! $slot->booking_id) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if ($slot->status === 'held' && $slot->expires_at && $slot->expires_at->isPast()) {
                        $this->releaseBookingSlots($slot->booking_id, true);
                        continue;
                    }

                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'slot' => 'Slot ' . jam($slot->slot_time) . ' di ' . $court->name . ' baru saja diambil operator lain. Silakan pilih jam lain.',
                    ]);
                }

                $booking = Booking::create([
                    'code' => $this->numbers->next('BK', now()->format('Ymd'), 4),
                    'member_id' => $member?->id,
                    'customer_name' => $data['customer_name'],
                    'customer_phone' => $data['customer_phone'] ?? null,
                    'court_id' => $court->id,
                    'booking_date' => $date->toDateString(),
                    'start_time' => $quote['start_time'],
                    'end_time' => $quote['end_time'],
                    'duration_minutes' => $quote['duration_minutes'],
                    'base_amount' => $quote['base_amount'],
                    'discount_amount' => $quote['discount_amount'],
                    'total_amount' => $quote['total_amount'],
                    'paid_amount' => 0,
                    'payment_status' => 'unpaid',
                    'status' => $hold ? 'held' : 'confirmed',
                    'source' => $data['source'] ?? 'walkin',
                    'created_by' => $user->id,
                    'expires_at' => $expiresAt,
                    'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                ]);

                foreach ($quote['slots'] as $slot) {
                    BookingSlot::create([
                        'booking_id' => $booking->id,
                        'court_id' => $court->id,
                        'slot_date' => $date->toDateString(),
                        'slot_time' => $slot['time'],
                        'price' => $slot['price'],
                        'category' => $slot['category'],
                    ]);
                }

                CourtSlot::query()
                    ->where('court_id', $court->id)
                    ->whereDate('slot_date', $date->toDateString())
                    ->whereIn('slot_time', $slotTimes)
                    ->update([
                        'booking_id' => $booking->id,
                        'status' => $hold ? 'held' : 'confirmed',
                        'expires_at' => $expiresAt,
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);

                if (! $hold && ! empty($data['payment_amount']) && (float) $data['payment_amount'] > 0) {
                    $this->applyPayment($booking, $member, $user, $data);
                }

                $this->audit->log('booking.create', 'booking', $booking->id, null, $booking->fresh()->toArray());

                return $booking->fresh(['court', 'member', 'slots']);
            });
        } catch (\Illuminate\Database\QueryException $e) {
            if (str_contains(strtolower($e->getMessage()), 'duplicate')) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'slot' => 'Slot baru saja diambil operator lain. Silakan pilih jam lain.',
                ]);
            }

            throw $e;
        }
    }

    private function applyPayment(Booking $booking, ?Member $member, User $user, array $data): void
    {
        $amount = min((float) $data['payment_amount'], (float) $booking->total_amount);
        $method = $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash';

        if ($method === 'deposit') {
            if (! $member) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['payment_method' => 'Pembayaran deposit memerlukan member.']);
            }

            $this->members->useDeposit($member, $amount, 'booking', $booking->id, $user);
            $this->payments->record('booking', $booking->id, 'deposit', $amount, $user, null, null, 'Pembayaran booking dengan deposit');
        } else {
            $this->payments->record('booking', $booking->id, $method, $amount, $user, $data['payment_reference'] ?? null, null, 'Pembayaran booking ' . $booking->code);
        }

        $paid = (float) $booking->paid_amount + $amount;
        $status = $paid >= (float) $booking->total_amount ? 'paid' : ($paid > 0 ? 'partial' : 'unpaid');

        $booking->update(['paid_amount' => $paid, 'payment_status' => $status]);
    }

    public function addPayment(Booking $booking, string $method, float $amount, User $user, ?string $reference = null): Payment
    {
        if (in_array($booking->status, ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking' => 'Booking ini tidak dapat dibayar.']);
        }

        $remaining = (float) $booking->total_amount - (float) $booking->paid_amount;
        if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > $remaining) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['amount' => 'Nominal pembayaran tidak valid.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($booking, $method, $amount, $user, $reference) {
            if ($method === 'deposit') {
                if (! $booking->member) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['payment_method' => 'Pembayaran deposit memerlukan member.']);
                }
                $this->members->useDeposit($booking->member, $amount, 'booking', $booking->id, $user);
                $payment = $this->payments->record('booking', $booking->id, 'deposit', $amount, $user, null, null, 'Pembayaran booking dengan deposit');
            } else {
                $payment = $this->payments->record('booking', $booking->id, $method, $amount, $user, $reference, null, 'Pembayaran booking ' . $booking->code);
            }

            $paid = (float) $booking->paid_amount + $amount;
            $booking->update([
                'paid_amount' => $paid,
                'payment_status' => $paid >= (float) $booking->total_amount ? 'paid' : 'partial',
            ]);

            $this->audit->log('booking.payment', 'booking', $booking->id, null, ['amount' => $amount, 'method' => $method]);

            return $payment;
        });
    }

    public function cancel(Booking $booking, string $reason, User $user): BookingCancellation
    {
        if (in_array($booking->status, ['cancelled', 'completed', 'no_show', 'expired'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking' => 'Booking ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($booking, $reason, $user) {
            $start = Carbon::parse($booking->booking_date->toDateString() . ' ' . $booking->start_time);
            $hours = now()->diffInMinutes($start, false) / 60;

            $pct = $hours >= 24 ? 100 : ($hours >= 6 ? 50 : 0);
            $refund = round((float) $booking->paid_amount * ($pct / 100), 2);

            if ($refund > 0) {
                $cashPaid = (float) Payment::query()
                    ->where('ref_type', 'booking')
                    ->where('ref_id', $booking->id)
                    ->where('method', 'cash')
                    ->sum('amount');

                $cashRefund = min($refund, $cashPaid);
                if ($cashRefund > 0) {
                    $this->cash->recordCashOut(
                        $cashRefund,
                        'refund',
                        'Refund pembatalan ' . $booking->code,
                        'booking_cancellation',
                        $booking->id,
                        $user
                    );
                }

                if ($booking->member) {
                    $depositPaid = (float) Payment::query()
                        ->where('ref_type', 'booking')
                        ->where('ref_id', $booking->id)
                        ->where('method', 'deposit')
                        ->sum('amount');
                    $depositRefund = min($refund - $cashRefund, $depositPaid);

                    if ($depositRefund > 0) {
                        $member = Member::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($booking->member_id);
                        $newBalance = (float) $member->deposit_balance + $depositRefund;
                        Deposit::create([
                            'code' => $this->numbers->next('DEP', now()->format('Ymd'), 4),
                            'member_id' => $member->id,
                            'type' => 'refund',
                            'amount' => $depositRefund,
                            'balance_after' => $newBalance,
                            'ref_type' => 'booking_cancellation',
                            'ref_id' => $booking->id,
                            'created_by' => $user->id,
                        ]);
                        $member->update(['deposit_balance' => $newBalance]);
                    }
                }
            }

            $cancellation = BookingCancellation::create([
                'booking_id' => $booking->id,
                'cancelled_at' => now(),
                'reason' => $reason,
                'refund_amount' => $refund,
                'refund_pct' => $pct,
                'approved_by' => $user->id,
            ]);

            $booking->update(['status' => 'cancelled']);
            $this->releaseBookingSlots($booking->id);

            $this->audit->log('booking.cancel', 'booking', $booking->id, ['status' => $booking->getOriginal('status')], [
                'status' => 'cancelled',
                'refund_amount' => $refund,
                'refund_pct' => $pct,
            ], $reason);

            return $cancellation;
        });
    }

    public function checkIn(Booking $booking): Booking
    {
        if (! in_array($booking->status, ['confirmed'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking' => 'Hanya booking terkonfirmasi yang dapat check-in.']);
        }

        $booking->update(['status' => 'checked_in', 'checked_in_at' => now()]);
        $this->audit->log('booking.checkin', 'booking', $booking->id, null, ['status' => 'checked_in']);

        return $booking;
    }

    public function checkOut(Booking $booking): Booking
    {
        if (! in_array($booking->status, ['checked_in'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking' => 'Booking belum check-in.']);
        }

        $booking->update(['status' => 'completed', 'checked_out_at' => now()]);
        $this->audit->log('booking.checkout', 'booking', $booking->id, null, ['status' => 'completed']);

        return $booking;
    }

    public function noShow(Booking $booking): Booking
    {
        if (! in_array($booking->status, ['confirmed', 'held'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking' => 'Status booking tidak dapat ditandai no-show.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($booking) {
            $booking->update(['status' => 'no_show']);
            $this->releaseBookingSlots($booking->id);

            if ($booking->member_id) {
                $member = Member::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($booking->member_id);
                $count = Booking::query()
                    ->where('member_id', $member->id)
                    ->where('status', 'no_show')
                    ->whereDate('booking_date', '>=', now()->subDays(30)->toDateString())
                    ->count();

                $member->update([
                    'no_show_count' => $count,
                    'status' => $count >= 3 && ! in_array($member->status, ['blacklist', 'suspend'], true)
                        ? 'perlu_konfirmasi'
                        : $member->status,
                ]);
            }

            $this->audit->log('booking.noshow', 'booking', $booking->id, null, ['status' => 'no_show']);

            return $booking;
        });
    }

    public function releaseExpiredHolds(): int
    {
        $expired = Booking::query()
            ->where('status', 'held')
            ->whereNotNull('expires_at')
            ->where('expires_at', '<', now())
            ->get();

        foreach ($expired as $booking) {
            $booking->update(['status' => 'expired']);
            $this->releaseBookingSlots($booking->id);
        }

        return $expired->count();
    }

    public function releaseBookingSlots(int $bookingId, bool $onlyExpiredBooking = false): void
    {
        if ($onlyExpiredBooking) {
            $booking = Booking::find($bookingId);
            if ($booking && $booking->status === 'held' && $booking->expires_at?->isPast()) {
                $booking->update(['status' => 'expired']);
            }
        }

        CourtSlot::query()
            ->where('booking_id', $bookingId)
            ->update([
                'booking_id' => null,
                'status' => 'open',
                'expires_at' => null,
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
    }

    public function createRecurring(array $data, User $user): BookingRecurring
    {
        return BookingRecurring::create([
            'member_id' => $data['member_id'] ?? null,
            'customer_name' => $data['customer_name'],
            'customer_phone' => $data['customer_phone'] ?? null,
            'court_id' => $data['court_id'],
            'day_of_week' => (int) $data['day_of_week'],
            'start_time' => $data['start_time'],
            'end_time' => $data['end_time'],
            'valid_from' => $data['valid_from'],
            'valid_until' => $data['valid_until'],
            'status' => 'aktif',
            'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
            'created_by' => $user->id,
        ]);
    }

    public function stopRecurring(BookingRecurring $recurring): void
    {
        $recurring->update(['status' => 'dihentikan']);
        $this->audit->log('booking.recurring.stop', 'booking_recurring', $recurring->id, null, ['status' => 'dihentikan']);
    }

    public function generateRecurringBookings(): int
    {
        $created = 0;

        foreach (BookingRecurring::query()->where('status', 'aktif')->get() as $recurring) {
            $from = max(now()->startOfDay(), $recurring->valid_from->copy()->startOfDay());
            $limitDays = $recurring->member_id ? (int) setting('member_advance_days', 30) : (int) setting('public_advance_days', 14);
            $until = min(now()->startOfDay()->addDays($limitDays), $recurring->valid_until->copy()->endOfDay());
            $cursor = $from->copy();

            while ($cursor <= $until) {
                if ((int) $cursor->dayOfWeek === (int) $recurring->day_of_week) {
                    $exists = Booking::query()
                        ->where('court_id', $recurring->court_id)
                        ->whereDate('booking_date', $cursor->toDateString())
                        ->where('start_time', $recurring->start_time)
                        ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired'])
                        ->exists();

                    if (! $exists) {
                        $duration = $this->pricing->toMinutes($recurring->end_time) - $this->pricing->toMinutes($recurring->start_time);

                        try {
                            $this->create([
                                'member_id' => $recurring->member_id,
                                'customer_name' => $recurring->customer_name,
                                'customer_phone' => $recurring->customer_phone,
                                'court_id' => $recurring->court_id,
                                'booking_date' => $cursor->toDateString(),
                                'start_time' => $recurring->start_time,
                                'duration_minutes' => $duration,
                                'source' => 'wa',
                                'notes' => 'Booking rutin otomatis',
                            ], auth()->user() ?? User::query()->where('role', 'owner')->firstOrFail());
                            $created++;
                        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
                            // Slot sudah terisi — lewati tanggal ini.
                        }
                    }
                }

                $cursor->addDay();
            }
        }

        return $created;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\InventoryMovement;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\StockOpname;
use App\Models\StockOpnameItem;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class InventoryService
{
    public function __construct(
        private DocumentNumberService $numbers,
        private AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {
    }

    public function move(
        Product $product,
        string $type,
        int $qty,
        float $unitCost = 0,
        ?string $refType = null,
        ?int $refId = null,
        ?string $reason = null,
        ?string $notes = null,
        ?User $user = null,
        ?string $directionLabel = null
    ): InventoryMovement {
        if (! in_array($type, ['in', 'out', 'adjust'], true)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Tipe movement tidak valid.');
        }

        if ($type !== 'adjust' && $qty <= 0) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['qty' => 'Qty harus lebih dari nol.']);
        }

        if ($type === 'adjust' && $qty === 0) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['qty' => 'Qty penyesuaian tidak boleh nol.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $type, $qty, $unitCost, $refType, $refId, $reason, $notes, $user) {
            $locked = Product::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($product->id);
            $stock = (int) $locked->stock_qty;
            $oldCost = (float) $locked->cost_price;

            $newStock = match ($type) {
                'in' => $stock + $qty,
                'out' => $stock - $qty,
                'adjust' => $stock + $qty,
            };

            if ($newStock < 0 && ! $locked->allow_negative) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'stock' => 'Stok ' . $locked->name . ' tidak mencukupi (tersedia ' . $stock . ' ' . $locked->base_unit . ').',
                ]);
            }

            $movementQty = $type === 'adjust' ? $qty : $qty;
            $cost = $unitCost > 0 ? $unitCost : $oldCost;

            if ($type === 'in' && $newStock > 0) {
                $cost = round((($stock * $oldCost) + ($qty * ($unitCost > 0 ? $unitCost : $oldCost))) / $newStock, 2);
                $locked->cost_price = $cost;
            }

            $locked->stock_qty = $newStock;
            $locked->save();

            $movement = InventoryMovement::create([
                'product_id' => $locked->id,
                'type' => $type,
                'qty' => $movementQty,
                'unit_cost' => $cost,
                'balance_after' => $newStock,
                'ref_type' => $refType,
                'ref_id' => $refId,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'notes' => $notes,
                'created_by' => $user?->id ?? auth()->id(),
            ]);

            return $movement->load('product', 'creator');
        });
    }

    public function stockIn(Product $product, int $qty, float $unitCost, ?string $refType, ?int $refId, ?string $notes, ?User $user = null, ?string $reason = null): InventoryMovement
    {
        return $this->move($product, 'in', $qty, $unitCost, $refType, $refId, $reason ?? 'stok_masuk', $notes, $user);
    }

    public function stockOut(Product $product, int $qty, ?string $refType, ?int $refId, ?string $reason, ?string $notes = null, ?User $user = null): InventoryMovement
    {
        return $this->move($product, 'out', $qty, 0, $refType, $refId, $reason, $notes, $user);
    }

    public function openingStock(Product $product, int $qty, float $unitCost, ?User $user = null): ?InventoryMovement
    {
        if ($qty <= 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->stockIn($product, $qty, $unitCost, 'opening', null, 'Stok awal saat produk dibuat', $user, 'stok_awal');
    }

    public function stockValue(): float
    {
        return (float) Product::query()
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->get()
            ->sum(fn ($product) => (float) $product->stock_qty * (float) $product->cost_price);
    }

    public function finalizeOpname(array $counts, array $reasons, User $user, ?string $notes = null): StockOpname
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($counts, $reasons, $user, $notes) {
            $opname = StockOpname::create([
                'code' => $this->numbers->next('OPN', now()->format('Ym'), 2),
                'opname_date' => now()->toDateString(),
                'status' => 'draft',
                'created_by' => $user->id,
                'notes' => $notes,
            ]);

            $totalVariance = 0.0;
            $count = 0;

            foreach ($counts as $productId => $physical) {
                if ($physical === null || $physical === '') {
                    continue;
                }

                $product = Product::query()->lockForUpdate()->find((int) $productId);
                if (! $product) {
                    continue;
                }

                $system = (int) $product->stock_qty;
                $physical = (int) $physical;
                $variance = $physical - $system;
                $unitCost = (float) $product->cost_price;
                $varianceValue = $variance * $unitCost;

                StockOpnameItem::create([
                    'stock_opname_id' => $opname->id,
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'system_qty' => $system,
                    'physical_qty' => $physical,
                    'variance' => $variance,
                    'unit_cost' => $unitCost,
                    'variance_value' => $varianceValue,
                    'reason' => $reasons[$productId] ?? null,
                ]);

                if ($variance !== 0) {
                    $this->move(
                        $product,
                        'adjust',
                        $variance,
                        $unitCost,
                        'opname',
                        $opname->id,
                        $reasons[$productId] ?? 'Hasil stock opname',
                        'Opname ' . $opname->code,
                        $user
                    );
                }

                $totalVariance += $varianceValue;
                $count++;
            }

            $opname->update([
                'status' => 'finalized',
                'total_variance_value' => $totalVariance,
                'finalized_by' => $user->id,
                'finalized_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->audit->log('stock.opname', 'stock_opname', $opname->id, null, [
                'items' => $count,
                'total_variance_value' => $totalVariance,
            ], $notes);

            return $opname->load('items.product');
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Member;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\PosSale;
use App\Models\PosSaleItem;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class PosService
{
    public function __construct(
        private DocumentNumberService $numbers,
        private InventoryService $inventory,
        private CashService $cash,
        private MemberService $members,
        private PaymentService $payments,
        private AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {
    }

    public function checkout(
        User $cashier,
        array $items,
        ?Member $member,
        array $payment,
        float $manualDiscount = 0,
        ?string $discountReason = null,
        ?string $ownerPin = null,
        ?int $bookingId = null,
        ?string $notes = null
    ): array {
        $merged = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $id = (int) ($item['product_id'] ?? 0);
            $qty = (int) ($item['qty'] ?? 0);
            if ($id > 0 && $qty > 0) {
                $merged[$id] = ($merged[$id] ?? 0) + $qty;
            }
        }

        if (empty($merged)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['items' => 'Keranjang masih kosong.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($cashier, $merged, $member, $payment, $manualDiscount, $discountReason, $ownerPin, $bookingId, $notes) {
            $products = Product::query()
                ->whereIn('id', array_keys($merged))
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->get()
                ->keyBy('id');

            $subtotal = 0.0;
            $lines = [];

            foreach ($merged as $productId => $qty) {
                $product = $products->get($productId);
                if (! $product || ! $product->is_active) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['items' => 'Produk tidak ditemukan atau tidak aktif.']);
                }

                if ($qty > $product->stock_qty && ! $product->allow_negative) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'items' => 'Stok ' . $product->name . ' tersisa ' . $product->stock_qty . ' ' . $product->base_unit . '.',
                    ]);
                }

                $lineSubtotal = (float) $product->sell_price * $qty;
                $subtotal += $lineSubtotal;
                $lines[] = [
                    'product' => $product,
                    'qty' => $qty,
                    'unit_price' => (float) $product->sell_price,
                    'cost_price' => (float) $product->cost_price,
                    'amount' => $lineSubtotal,
                ];
            }

            $memberDiscount = $member ? round($subtotal * ($member->discountPct() / 100), 2) : 0.0;
            $manualDiscount = max($manualDiscount, 0);

            $discountLimitPct = (float) setting('discount_limit_pct', 20);
            if ($manualDiscount > 0 && $manualDiscount > $subtotal * ($discountLimitPct / 100)) {
                if (! $discountReason) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['discount_reason' => 'Diskon melebihi batas wajib disertai alasan.']);
                }

                $owner = User::query()->where('role', 'owner')->where('is_active', true)->get()
                    ->first(fn ($candidate) => $candidate->verifyPin($ownerPin));

                if (! $owner) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['owner_pin' => 'PIN Owner tidak valid untuk diskon di atas batas.']);
                }
            }

            $discount = $memberDiscount + $manualDiscount;
            if ($discount > $subtotal) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['discount_amount' => 'Diskon melebihi subtotal.']);
            }

            $tax = 0.0;
            $total = $subtotal - $discount + $tax;

            $qris = max((float) ($payment['qris'] ?? 0), 0);
            $transfer = max((float) ($payment['transfer'] ?? 0), 0);
            $debit = max((float) ($payment['debit'] ?? 0), 0);
            $deposit = max((float) ($payment['deposit'] ?? 0), 0);
            $nonCash = $qris + $transfer + $debit + $deposit;

            if ($nonCash > $total + 0.01) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['payment' => 'Pembayaran non-tunai melebihi total transaksi.']);
            }

            $cashApplied = max(round($total - $nonCash, 2), 0);
            $cashReceived = max((float) ($payment['cash_received'] ?? $cashApplied), 0);

            if ($cashReceived + 0.01 < $cashApplied) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['payment' => 'Uang tunai diterima kurang dari jumlah yang harus dibayar.']);
            }

            $change = max(round($cashReceived - $cashApplied, 2), 0);

            if ($cashApplied > 0) {
                $this->cash->requireActiveSession($cashier);
            }

            if ($deposit > 0) {
                if (! $member) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['member_id' => 'Pembayaran deposit memerlukan member.']);
                }
                if ((float) $member->deposit_balance < $deposit) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['deposit' => 'Saldo deposit member tidak mencukupi.']);
                }
            }

            $booking = $bookingId ? Booking::find($bookingId) : null;
            if ($booking && $booking->status === 'cancelled') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking_id' => 'Booking sudah dibatalkan.']);
            }

            $sale = PosSale::create([
                'code' => $this->numbers->next('TRX', now()->format('Ymd'), 4),
                'cash_session_id' => $this->cash->activeSession($cashier)?->id,
                'member_id' => $member?->id,
                'booking_id' => $booking?->id,
                'subtotal' => $subtotal,
                'discount_amount' => $discount,
                'tax_amount' => $tax,
                'total_amount' => $total,
                'paid_amount' => $total,
                'payment_status' => 'paid',
                'status' => 'paid',
                'cashier_id' => $cashier->id,
                'notes' => $notes,
            ]);

            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                PosSaleItem::create([
                    'pos_sale_id' => $sale->id,
                    'product_id' => $line['product']->id,
                    'qty' => $line['qty'],

                    'cost_price_snapshot' => $line['cost_price'],

                ]);

                    $line['qty'],
                    $line['cost_price'],
                    'pos',
                    $sale->id,
                    'penjualan_pos',
                    'Penjualan ' . $sale->code,
                    $cashier
                );
            }

            if ($deposit > 0) {
                $this->members->useDeposit($member, $deposit, 'pos', $sale->id, $cashier);

            foreach (['qris' => $qris, 'transfer' => $transfer, 'debit' => $debit] as $method => $amount) {
                if ($amount > 0) {

            if ($cashApplied > 0) {

            ]);

                'change' => $change,
                'cash_applied' => $cashApplied,
                'cash_received' => $cashReceived,
                'payments' => $createdPayments,
            ];
        });
    }

    public function void(PosSale $sale, User $user, string $reason, string $ownerPin, bool $restoreStock = true): PosSale
    {
        if ($sale->status === 'void') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['sale' => 'Transaksi ini sudah di-void.']);
        }

        if (! $sale->created_at->isToday()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['sale' => 'Void hanya dapat dilakukan pada hari transaksi yang sama.']);
        }

        if ($sale->cashier_id !== $user->id && ! $user->isAdmin()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['sale' => 'Hanya kasir transaksi atau admin yang dapat melakukan void.']);
        }

        $owner = User::query()->where('role', 'owner')->where('is_active', true)->get()
            ->first(fn ($candidate) => $candidate->verifyPin($ownerPin));

        if (! $owner) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['owner_pin' => 'PIN Owner tidak valid.']);
        }

        $cashAmount = (float) $sale->payments()->where('method', 'cash')->sum('amount');

        if ($cashAmount > 0) {
            $session = $sale->cashSession;
            if (! $session || $session->status !== 'open') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['sale' => 'Sesi kas transaksi sudah ditutup. Void tunai harus diselesaikan lewat jurnal penyesuaian Owner.']);
            }
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($sale, $user, $reason, $restoreStock, $cashAmount) {
            if ($restoreStock) {
                foreach ($sale->items as $item) {
                    $this->inventory->move(
                        $item->product,
                        'in',
                        $item->qty,
                        (float) $item->cost_price_snapshot,
                        'pos_void',
                        $sale->id,
                        'void_penjualan',
                        'Void ' . $sale->code . ': ' . $reason,
                        $user
                    );
                }
            }

            if ($cashAmount > 0) {
                $this->cash->recordCashOut(
                    $cashAmount,
                    'refund',
                    'Void transaksi ' . $sale->code,
                    'pos_void',
                    $sale->id,
                    $user,
                    null,
                    $sale->cashSession
                );
            }

            $before = $sale->toArray();
            $sale->update([
                'status' => 'void',
                'payment_status' => 'void',
                'voided_at' => now(),
                'void_reason' => $reason,
                'voided_by' => $user->id,
            ]);

            $this->audit->log('pos.void', 'pos_sale', $sale->id, $before, [
                'status' => 'void',
                'reason' => $reason,
                'restore_stock' => $restoreStock,
            ], $reason);

            return $sale->refresh();
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Expense;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Models\PurchaseOrderItem;
use App\Models\RecurringExpense;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class PurchaseOrderService
{
    public function __construct(
        private DocumentNumberService $numbers,
        private InventoryService $inventory,
        private CashService $cash,
        private AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {
    }

    public function create(array $data, User $user, bool $saveDraft = false): PurchaseOrder
    {
        $items = array_values(array_filter($data['items'] ?? [], fn ($item) => ! empty($item['description']) && (float) ($item['qty'] ?? 0) > 0));

        if (empty($items)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['items' => 'Minimal satu item PO harus diisi.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $user, $saveDraft, $items) {
            $subtotal = 0.0;
            $types = [];

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                $subtotal += (float) $item['qty'] * (float) $item['unit_price'];
                $types[] = $item['item_type'] ?? 'product';
            }

            $discount = (float) ($data['discount_amount'] ?? 0);
            $tax = (float) ($data['tax_amount'] ?? 0);
            $shipping = (float) ($data['shipping_amount'] ?? 0);
            $total = max($subtotal - $discount + $tax + $shipping, 0);

            $poType = count(array_unique($types)) > 1 ? 'mixed' : ($types[0] ?? 'product');
            $priority = $data['priority'] ?? 'normal';
            $paymentMethod = $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash';

            $status = 'draft';
            if (! $saveDraft) {
                $adminThreshold = (float) setting('po_admin_threshold', 500000);
                $urgentThreshold = (float) setting('po_urgent_cash_threshold', 250000);
                $autoApprove = $user->isAdmin() && (
                    $total <= $adminThreshold
                    || ($priority === 'urgent' && $paymentMethod === 'cash' && $total <= $urgentThreshold)
                );

                $status = $autoApprove ? 'approved' : 'submitted';
            }

            $po = PurchaseOrder::create([
                'code' => $this->numbers->next('PO', now()->format('Ymd'), 3),
                'supplier_id' => $data['supplier_id'] ?? null,
                'supplier_name' => $data['supplier_name'] ?? null,
                'po_type' => $poType,
                'request_date' => $data['request_date'] ?? now()->toDateString(),
                'expected_date' => $data['expected_date'] ?? null,
                'status' => $status,
                'subtotal' => $subtotal,
                'discount_amount' => $discount,
                'tax_amount' => $tax,
                'shipping_amount' => $shipping,
                'total_amount' => $total,
                'payment_method' => $paymentMethod,
                'priority' => $priority,
                'requested_by' => $user->id,
                'approved_by' => $status === 'approved' ? $user->id : null,
                'approved_at' => $status === 'approved' ? now() : null,
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
            ]);

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                PurchaseOrderItem::create([
                    'purchase_order_id' => $po->id,
                    'item_type' => $item['item_type'] ?? 'product',
                    'product_id' => ($item['item_type'] ?? 'product') === 'product' ? ($item['product_id'] ?? null) : null,
                    'expense_category' => $item['expense_category'] ?? null,
                    'description' => $item['description'],
                    'qty' => $item['qty'],
                    'unit' => $item['unit'] ?? null,
                    'unit_price' => $item['unit_price'],
                    'amount' => (float) $item['qty'] * (float) $item['unit_price'],
                ]);
            }

            $this->audit->log('po.create', 'purchase_order', $po->id, null, $po->load('items')->toArray());

            return $po->load('items.product', 'supplier', 'requester');
        });
    }

    public function approve(PurchaseOrder $po, User $user, ?string $note = null): PurchaseOrder
    {
        if ($po->status !== 'submitted') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['po' => 'PO ini tidak dalam status menunggu approval.']);
        }

        if (! $user->canApprovePo((float) $po->total_amount)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['po' => 'Nominal PO melebihi batas approval Anda.']);
        }

        $po->update([
            'status' => 'approved',
            'approved_by' => $user->id,
            'approved_at' => now(),
            'notes' => trim(($po->notes ? $po->notes . "\n" : '') . ($note ? 'Approval: ' . $note : '')),
        ]);

        $this->audit->log('po.approve', 'purchase_order', $po->id, null, ['status' => 'approved'], $note);

        return $po->refresh();
    }

    public function reject(PurchaseOrder $po, User $user, ?string $note = null): PurchaseOrder
    {
        if (! in_array($po->status, ['submitted', 'draft'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['po' => 'PO ini tidak dapat ditolak.']);
        }

        $po->update([
            'status' => 'rejected',
            'notes' => trim(($po->notes ? $po->notes . "\n" : '') . ($note ? 'Ditolak: ' . $note : '')),
        ]);

        $this->audit->log('po.reject', 'purchase_order', $po->id, null, ['status' => 'rejected'], $note);

        return $po->refresh();
    }

    public function receive(PurchaseOrder $po, array $receivedQuantities, User $user, ?string $attachment = null): PurchaseOrder
    {
        if (! in_array($po->status, ['approved', 'received'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['po' => 'PO belum disetujui atau sudah selesai.']);
        }

        if ($po->payment_method === 'cash' && (float) $po->total_amount < (float) setting('po_cash_receipt_threshold', 500000) && ! $attachment && ! $po->attachment) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['attachment' => 'Foto nota wajib dilampirkan untuk pembelian tunai di bawah Rp 500.000.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($po, $receivedQuantities, $user, $attachment) {
            $po->load('items.product');
            $allReceived = true;

            foreach ($po->items as $item) {
                $qtyNow = min((float) ($receivedQuantities[$item->id] ?? 0), $item->remainingQty());
                if ($qtyNow <= 0) {
                    if ($item->remainingQty() > 0) {
                        $allReceived = false;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if ($item->item_type === 'product' && $item->product) {
                    $product = $item->product;
                    $isPurchaseUnit = $item->unit && $item->unit === $product->purchase_unit && $product->conversion_qty > 1;
                    $baseQty = (int) round($qtyNow * ($isPurchaseUnit ? $product->conversion_qty : 1));
                    $unitCost = $isPurchaseUnit ? ((float) $item->unit_price / $product->conversion_qty) : (float) $item->unit_price;

                    $this->inventory->move(
                        $product,
                        'in',
                        $baseQty,
                        $unitCost,
                        'po',
                        $po->id,
                        'penerimaan_po',
                        'Penerimaan ' . $po->code,
                        $user
                    );
                } elseif ($item->item_type === 'expense') {
                    $amount = $qtyNow * (float) $item->unit_price;

                    Expense::create([
                        'code' => $this->numbers->next('EXP', now()->format('Ymd'), 4),
                        'category' => $item->expense_category ?: 'lain_lain',
                        'description' => $item->description,
                        'amount' => $amount,
                        'expense_date' => now()->toDateString(),
                        'payment_method' => $po->payment_method,
                        'cash_session_id' => $po->payment_method === 'cash' ? $this->cash->activeSession($user)?->id : null,
                        'purchase_order_id' => $po->id,
                        'attachment' => $attachment ?: $po->attachment,
                        'created_by' => $user->id,
                    ]);

                    if ($po->payment_method === 'cash') {
                        $this->cash->recordCashOut(
                            $amount,
                            'pembelian',
                            'Penerimaan PO ' . $po->code . ' — ' . $item->description,
                            'purchase_order',
                            $po->id,
                            $user,
                            $attachment ?: $po->attachment
                        );
                    }
                }

                $item->update(['received_qty' => (float) $item->received_qty + $qtyNow]);

                if ((float) $item->received_qty < (float) $item->qty) {
                    $allReceived = false;
                }
            }

            if ($allReceived) {
                $po->update(['status' => 'received', 'received_at' => now(), 'attachment' => $attachment ?: $po->attachment]);
            } else {
                $po->update(['status' => 'received']);
            }

            $this->audit->log('po.receive', 'purchase_order', $po->id, null, [
                'status' => $po->status,
                'all_received' => $allReceived,
            ]);

            return $po->refresh()->load('items.product');
        });
    }

    public function createExpense(array $data, User $user, ?string $attachment = null): Expense
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $user, $attachment) {
            $expense = Expense::create([
                'code' => $this->numbers->next('EXP', now()->format('Ymd'), 4),
                'category' => $data['category'],
                'description' => $data['description'],
                'amount' => $data['amount'],
                'expense_date' => $data['expense_date'] ?? now()->toDateString(),
                'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                'cash_session_id' => ($data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash') === 'cash' ? $this->cash->activeSession($user)?->id : null,
                'attachment' => $attachment,
                'created_by' => $user->id,
            ]);

            if (($data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash') === 'cash') {
                $this->cash->recordCashOut(
                    (float) $data['amount'],
                    'kas_kecil',
                    $data['description'],
                    'expense',
                    $expense->id,
                    $user,
                    $attachment
                );
            }

            $this->audit->log('expense.create', 'expense', $expense->id, null, $expense->toArray());

            return $expense;
        });
    }

    public function createSupplier(array $data): Supplier
    {
        $supplier = Supplier::create($data);
        $this->audit->log('supplier.create', 'supplier', $supplier->id, null, $supplier->toArray());

        return $supplier;
    }

    public function createRecurringExpense(array $data): RecurringExpense
    {
        return RecurringExpense::create($data);
    }

    public function generateRecurringExpenses(): int
    {
        $generated = 0;

        foreach (RecurringExpense::query()->where('is_active', true)->get() as $template) {
            if ((int) $template->day_of_month !== (int) now()->day) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($template->last_generated && $template->last_generated->isSameMonth(now())) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->create([
                'supplier_name' => 'Biaya Rutin',
                'po_type' => 'expense',
                'request_date' => now()->toDateString(),
                'expected_date' => now()->toDateString(),
                'payment_method' => 'transfer',
                'priority' => 'normal',
                'notes' => 'Draft otomatis dari biaya rutin: ' . $template->name,
                'items' => [[
                    'item_type' => 'expense',
                    'description' => $template->name,
                    'expense_category' => $template->category,
                    'qty' => 1,
                    'unit' => 'bulan',
                    'unit_price' => $template->amount,
                ]],
            ], User::query()->where('role', 'owner')->firstOrFail(), true);

            $template->update(['last_generated' => now()->toDateString()]);
            $generated++;
        }

        return $generated;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\BookingSlot;
use App\Models\CashSession;
use App\Models\Court;
use App\Models\Expense;
use App\Models\InventoryMovement;
use App\Models\Member;
use App\Models\MembershipType;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\PosSale;
use App\Models\PosSaleItem;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Models\StockOpname;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Carbon\CarbonPeriod;

class ReportService
{
    public function __construct(
        private PricingService $pricing,
        private InventoryService $inventory,
    ) {
    }

    public function dashboard(?Carbon $date = null): array
    {
        $date = ($date ?? now())->copy()->startOfDay();
        $bookingRevenue = (float) Booking::query()
            ->whereDate('booking_date', $date->toDateString())
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired'])
            ->sum('total_amount');

        $posQuery = PosSale::query()->whereDate('created_at', $date->toDateString())->where('status', 'paid');
        $posRevenue = (float) (clone $posQuery)->sum('total_amount');
        $posCount = (clone $posQuery)->count();
        $posItems = (int) PosSaleItem::query()
            ->whereHas('sale', fn ($q) => $q->whereDate('created_at', $date->toDateString())->where('status', 'paid'))
            ->sum('qty');

        $activeCourts = Court::query()->where('is_active', true)->count();
        $operatingHours = count($this->pricing->operatingHours());
        $availableSlots = max($activeCourts * $operatingHours * 2, 1);
        $bookedSlots = BookingSlot::query()
            ->whereDate('slot_date', $date->toDateString())
            ->whereHas('booking', fn ($q) => $q->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired']))
            ->count();

        $cashDifference = (float) CashSession::query()
            ->whereDate('opened_at', $date->toDateString())
            ->where('status', 'closed')
            ->sum('difference');

        $series = [];
        for ($i = 6; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $day = $date->copy()->subDays($i);
            $series[] = [
                'date' => $day,
                'label' => $day->locale('id')->translatedFormat('D'),
                'booking' => (float) Booking::query()
                    ->whereDate('booking_date', $day->toDateString())
                    ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired'])
                    ->sum('total_amount'),
                'pos' => (float) PosSale::query()
                    ->whereDate('created_at', $day->toDateString())
                    ->where('status', 'paid')
                    ->sum('total_amount'),
            ];
        }

        $todayBookings = Booking::query()
            ->with(['court', 'member'])
            ->whereDate('booking_date', $date->toDateString())
            ->orderBy('start_time')
            ->get();

        $lowStock = Product::query()->lowStock()->orderBy('stock_qty')->limit(5)->get();

        $pendingPos = PurchaseOrder::query()
            ->with('requester')
            ->whereIn('status', ['submitted', 'approved'])
            ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
            ->limit(5)
            ->get();

        $recentAudit = AuditLog::query()->with('user')->latest('created_at')->limit(7)->get();

        $expiringMembers = Member::query()
            ->whereHas('subscriptions', function ($query) {
                $query->where('status', 'aktif')
                    ->whereDate('end_date', '>=', now()->toDateString())
                    ->whereDate('end_date', '<=', now()->addDays(7)->toDateString());
            })
            ->count();

        return [
            'date' => $date,
            'booking_revenue' => $bookingRevenue,
            'pos_revenue' => $posRevenue,
            'total_revenue' => $bookingRevenue + $posRevenue,
            'pos_count' => $posCount,
            'pos_items' => $posItems,
            'atv' => $posCount > 0 ? $posRevenue / $posCount : 0,
            'occupancy' => min(100, round(($bookedSlots / $availableSlots) * 100)),
            'booked_slots' => $bookedSlots,
            'available_slots' => $availableSlots,
            'cash_difference' => $cashDifference,
            'series' => $series,
            'today_bookings' => $todayBookings,
            'low_stock' => $lowStock,
            'pending_pos' => $pendingPos,
            'recent_audit' => $recentAudit,
            'expiring_members' => $expiringMembers,
            'active_session' => CashSession::query()->where('cashier_id', auth()->id())->where('status', 'open')->latest('opened_at')->first(),
        ];
    }

    public function revenueReport(Carbon $from, Carbon $to): array
    {
        $booking = Booking::query()
            ->whereBetween('booking_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired'])
            ->selectRaw('SUM(total_amount) as total, COUNT(*) as count')
            ->first();

        $pos = PosSale::query()
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->where('status', 'paid')
            ->selectRaw('SUM(total_amount) as total, COUNT(*) as count')
            ->first();

        $membership = \App\Models\MemberSubscription::query()
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->selectRaw('SUM(price) as total, COUNT(*) as count')
            ->first();

        $bookingByDay = Booking::query()
            ->whereBetween('booking_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired'])
            ->selectRaw('DATE(booking_date) as d, SUM(total_amount) as total')
            ->groupBy('d')->pluck('total', 'd')->all();

        $posByDay = PosSale::query()
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->where('status', 'paid')
            ->selectRaw('DATE(created_at) as d, SUM(total_amount) as total')
            ->groupBy('d')->pluck('total', 'd')->all();

        $membershipByDay = \App\Models\MemberSubscription::query()
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->selectRaw('DATE(created_at) as d, SUM(price) as total')
            ->groupBy('d')->pluck('total', 'd')->all();

        $days = [];
        foreach (CarbonPeriod::create($from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->startOfDay()) as $day) {
            $key = $day->toDateString();
            $days[] = [
                'date' => $day->copy(),
                'booking' => (float) ($bookingByDay[$key] ?? 0),
                'pos' => (float) ($posByDay[$key] ?? 0),
                'membership' => (float) ($membershipByDay[$key] ?? 0),
                'total' => (float) ($bookingByDay[$key] ?? 0) + (float) ($posByDay[$key] ?? 0) + (float) ($membershipByDay[$key] ?? 0),
            ];
        }

        return [
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'booking_total' => (float) ($booking->total ?? 0),
            'booking_count' => (int) ($booking->count ?? 0),
            'pos_total' => (float) ($pos->total ?? 0),
            'pos_count' => (int) ($pos->count ?? 0),
            'membership_total' => (float) ($membership->total ?? 0),
            'membership_count' => (int) ($membership->count ?? 0),
            'total' => (float) ($booking->total ?? 0) + (float) ($pos->total ?? 0) + (float) ($membership->total ?? 0),
            'days' => $days,
        ];
    }

    public function occupancyReport(Carbon $from, Carbon $to): array
    {
        $days = $from->copy()->startOfDay()->diffInDays($to->copy()->startOfDay()) + 1;
        $courts = Court::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('sort_order')->get();
        $operatingHours = $this->pricing->operatingHours();
        $availableHours = max($courts->count() * count($operatingHours) * $days, 1);

        $bookedSlots = BookingSlot::query()
            ->whereBetween('slot_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])
            ->whereHas('booking', fn ($q) => $q->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired']))
            ->get();

        $bookedHours = $bookedSlots->count() * 0.5;
        $revenue = (float) $bookedSlots->sum('price');

        $perHour = [];
        foreach ($operatingHours as $hour) {
            $hourStart = $this->pricing->toMinutes($hour);
            $hourEnd = $hourStart + 60;
            $slots = $bookedSlots->filter(function ($slot) use ($hourStart, $hourEnd) {
                $m = $this->pricing->toMinutes($slot->slot_time);

                return $m >= $hourStart && $m < $hourEnd;
            });
            $perHour[] = [
                'hour' => $hour,
                'booked' => $slots->count(),
                'available' => $courts->count() * 2 * $days,
                'occupancy' => min(100, round($slots->count() / max($courts->count() * 2 * $days, 1) * 100)),
                'revenue' => (float) $slots->sum('price'),
            ];
        }

        $perCourt = $courts->map(function ($court) use ($bookedSlots, $days, $operatingHours) {
            $slots = $bookedSlots->where('court_id', $court->id);
            $available = count($operatingHours) * 2 * $days;

            return [
                'court' => $court,
                'booked' => $slots->count(),
                'hours' => $slots->count() * 0.5,
                'occupancy' => min(100, round($slots->count() / max($available, 1) * 100)),
                'revenue' => (float) $slots->sum('price'),
            ];
        });

        $sorted = collect($perHour)->sortBy('occupancy')->values();

        return [
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'occupancy' => min(100, round($bookedHours / $availableHours * 100)),
            'available_hours' => $availableHours,
            'booked_hours' => $bookedHours,
            'revenue_per_hour' => $bookedHours > 0 ? $revenue / $bookedHours : 0,
            'per_hour' => $perHour,
            'per_court' => $perCourt,
            'quietest' => $sorted->first(),
            'busiest' => $sorted->last(),
        ];
    }

    public function cashReport(Carbon $from, Carbon $to): array
    {
        $sessions = CashSession::query()
            ->with(['cashier', 'movements'])
            ->whereBetween('opened_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->orderBy('opened_at')
            ->get();

        $cashIn = 0.0;
        $cashOut = 0.0;
        $difference = 0.0;
        $byCashier = [];

        foreach ($sessions as $session) {
            $in = (float) $session->movements->where('type', 'in')->where('category', '!=', 'modal_awal')->sum('amount');
            $out = (float) $session->movements->where('type', 'out')->sum('amount');
            $cashIn += $in;
            $cashOut += $out;
            $difference += (float) ($session->difference ?? 0);

            $key = $session->cashier_id;
            $byCashier[$key] ??= [
                'cashier' => $session->cashier,
                'shifts' => 0,
                'cash_in' => 0.0,
                'difference' => 0.0,
            ];
            $byCashier[$key]['shifts']++;
            $byCashier[$key]['cash_in'] += $in;
            $byCashier[$key]['difference'] += (float) ($session->difference ?? 0);
        }

        $nonCash = Payment::query()
            ->whereBetween('paid_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->whereIn('method', ['qris', 'transfer', 'debit'])
            ->selectRaw('method, SUM(amount) as total')
            ->groupBy('method')
            ->pluck('total', 'method')
            ->all();

        return [
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'cash_in' => $cashIn,
            'cash_out' => $cashOut,
            'non_cash' => (float) array_sum($nonCash),
            'non_cash_by_method' => $nonCash,
            'difference' => $difference,
            'by_cashier' => collect($byCashier)->values(),
        ];
    }

    public function stockReport(Carbon $from, Carbon $to): array
    {
        $category = PosSaleItem::query()
            ->join('pos_sales', 'pos_sales.id', '=', 'pos_sale_items.pos_sale_id')
            ->join('products', 'products.id', '=', 'pos_sale_items.product_id')
            ->where('pos_sales.status', 'paid')
            ->whereBetween('pos_sales.created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->selectRaw('products.category as category, SUM(pos_sale_items.amount) as sales, SUM(pos_sale_items.cost_price_snapshot * pos_sale_items.qty) as cost, SUM(pos_sale_items.qty) as qty')
            ->groupBy('products.category')
            ->orderByDesc('sales')
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($row) {
                $row->profit = (float) $row->sales - (float) $row->cost;
                $row->margin = (float) $row->sales > 0 ? ($row->profit / (float) $row->sales) * 100 : 0;

                return $row;
            });

        $topProducts = PosSaleItem::query()
            ->join('pos_sales', 'pos_sales.id', '=', 'pos_sale_items.pos_sale_id')
            ->join('products', 'products.id', '=', 'pos_sale_items.product_id')
            ->where('pos_sales.status', 'paid')
            ->whereBetween('pos_sales.created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->selectRaw('products.id, products.name, products.stock_qty, products.base_unit, SUM(pos_sale_items.qty) as qty, SUM(pos_sale_items.amount) as sales, SUM(pos_sale_items.amount - (pos_sale_items.cost_price_snapshot * pos_sale_items.qty)) as profit')
            ->groupBy('products.id', 'products.name', 'products.stock_qty', 'products.base_unit')
            ->orderByDesc('qty')
            ->limit(8)
            ->get();

        $posSales = (float) $category->sum('sales');
        $posCost = (float) $category->sum('cost');

        return [
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'stock_value' => $this->inventory->stockValue(),
            'purchases' => (float) PurchaseOrder::query()
                ->where('status', 'received')
                ->whereBetween('received_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
                ->sum('total_amount'),
            'pos_sales' => $posSales,
            'pos_cost' => $posCost,
            'pos_profit' => $posSales - $posCost,
            'categories' => $category,
            'top_products' => $topProducts,
            'low_stock' => Product::query()->lowStock()->orderBy('stock_qty')->get(),
        ];
    }

    public function memberReport(Carbon $from, Carbon $to): array
    {
        $activeMembers = Member::query()
            ->whereHas('subscriptions', function ($q) {
                $q->where('status', 'aktif')->whereDate('end_date', '>=', now()->toDateString());
            })
            ->count();

        $newMembers = Member::query()->whereBetween('join_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])->count();
        $churn = Member::query()
            ->whereHas('subscriptions', function ($q) use ($to) {
                $q->where('status', 'aktif')->whereDate('end_date', '>=', $from->toDateString())->whereDate('end_date', '<=', $to->toDateString());
            })
            ->count();

        $membershipRevenue = (float) \App\Models\MemberSubscription::query()
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])
            ->sum('price');

        $perType = MembershipType::query()->get()->map(function ($type) {
            return [
                'type' => $type,
                'members' => Member::query()->where('member_type_id', $type->id)->count(),
                'revenue' => (float) \App\Models\MemberSubscription::query()->where('membership_type_id', $type->id)->sum('price'),
                'renewals' => (int) \App\Models\MemberSubscription::query()->where('membership_type_id', $type->id)->count(),
            ];
        });

        $topMembers = Member::query()
            ->withCount(['bookings' => fn ($q) => $q->whereBetween('booking_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'no_show', 'expired'])])
            ->orderByDesc('bookings_count')
            ->limit(5)
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($member) use ($from, $to) {
                $member->spent = (float) PosSale::query()->where('member_id', $member->id)->where('status', 'paid')
                    ->whereBetween('created_at', [$from->copy()->startOfDay(), $to->copy()->endOfDay()])->sum('total_amount');

                return $member;
            });

        $expiring = Member::query()
            ->with('activeSubscription')
            ->whereHas('subscriptions', function ($q) {
                $q->where('status', 'aktif')->whereDate('end_date', '>=', now()->toDateString())->whereDate('end_date', '<=', now()->addDays(7)->toDateString());
            })
            ->limit(10)->get();

        return [
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'active_members' => $activeMembers,
            'new_members' => $newMembers,
            'churn' => $churn,
            'membership_revenue' => $membershipRevenue,
            'per_type' => $perType,
            'top_members' => $topMembers,
            'expiring' => $expiring,
        ];
    }

    public function profitLoss(Carbon $from, Carbon $to): array
    {
        $revenue = $this->revenueReport($from, $to);
        $stock = $this->stockReport($from, $to);

        $expenses = Expense::query()
            ->whereBetween('expense_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])
            ->selectRaw('category, SUM(amount) as amount')
            ->groupBy('category')
            ->orderByDesc('amount')
            ->get();

        $totalExpenses = (float) $expenses->sum('amount');
        $gross = $revenue['total'] - $stock['pos_cost'];
        $net = $gross - $totalExpenses;

        return [
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'revenue' => $revenue,
            'hpp' => $stock['pos_cost'],
            'gross_profit' => $gross,
            'expenses' => $expenses,
            'total_expenses' => $totalExpenses,
            'net_profit' => $net,
            'gross_margin' => $revenue['total'] > 0 ? ($gross / $revenue['total']) * 100 : 0,
            'net_margin' => $revenue['total'] > 0 ? ($net / $revenue['total']) * 100 : 0,
            'stock' => $stock,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureRole
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, string ...$roles): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if (! $user || ! $user->is_active) {
            abort(403, 'Akun tidak aktif.');
        }

        if (! in_array($user->role, $roles, true)) {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke halaman ini.');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function showLogin()
    {
        if (Auth::check()) {
            return redirect()->route('dashboard');
        }

        return view('auth.login');
    }

    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        $credentials = $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        $key = 'login:' . strtolower($credentials['email']) . '|' . $request->ip();

        if (RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($key, 6)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => 'Terlalu banyak percobaan masuk. Coba lagi dalam ' . RateLimiter::availableIn($key) . ' detik.',
            ]);
        }

        if (! Auth::attempt($credentials, $request->boolean('remember'))) {
            RateLimiter::hit($key, 60);

            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => 'Email atau password tidak sesuai.',
            ]);
        }

        $user = Auth::user();

        if (! $user->is_active) {
            Auth::logout();
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => 'Akun ini dinonaktifkan. Hubungi Owner.',
            ]);
        }

        RateLimiter::clear($key);
        $request->session()->regenerate();
        $user->update(['last_login_at' => now()]);

        return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard'));
    }

    public function logout(Request $request)
    {
        Auth::logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect()->route('login');
    }
}
